subject: Weekly Forecast: Finalize Numbers & Submission Runbook
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Weekly Forecast: Finalize Numbers & Submission Runbook

Team —

Reminder: our final weekly submission for the Q3 commit window is today at 19:00 UTC. Please do the following before our 18:00 run-through: 

- Update stage flags in SFDC (Closed-Won, Commit, Commit-at-risk) for any movement since Friday.
- Enter the conservative/target numbers in the shared sheet linked below (use the Q3 tab).
- Attach redlines or procurement blockers to the deal record (DEAL SF-3421 for ACME).

Run-of-show for 18:00 call (30 min):
1) Quick roll (5 min): owners confirm line items in sheet
2) Top-10 whisper-check (10 min): any upside or risk movement?
3) Blockers & procurement ask (10 min): who needs legal/finance help
4) Final submission checklist (5 min): who presses submit in SFDC

Links & attachments:
- Shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XyForecastSheetExample
- Template: [attachment: Q3_forecast_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
- Runbook: [attachment: submission_runbook_v2.pdf (pdf)]

Ask: If you cannot make the 18:00 dry-run, reply now with your delegate and confirmed numbers. We will lock the submission at 19:00 UTC sharp.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 16:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Weekly Forecast: Finalize Numbers & Submission Runbook

Got it — I'll own the top-10 whisper-check and confirm the ACME line. I updated the sheet with conservative and target figures; ACME pipeline shows a $1.2M commit (conservative $950k).

I attached a short note on the two procurement items we escalated last week (PO timing + data residency ask).

Attachment: [procurement_notes_acme.docx (docx)]

Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Weekly Forecast: Finalize Numbers & Submission Runbook

Quick asks from Finance/Legal side before we lock: 
- Please ensure stage comments include the last buyer touchpoint and expected signature week (free text in SFDC).
- If a deal has an external procurement thread, paste the DocuSign link in the record; procurement will triage any PO timing risk.

Jamie — if ACME has any outstanding compliance packaging requests, drop them in the procurement thread (cc'd). We will escalate to SA if needed during the 18:00 call.

Irene
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Actions captured for submission at 19:00 UTC:
- Ben: verify final line items in sheet and press submit in SFDC (owner)
- Marissa: push ACME to Commit and upload procurement note
- Irene: stand by for any DocuSign escalation; finance to approve recognition cadence

Post-submission: I will run a short sanity check in the system and report any anomalies. If you see a discrepancy after 19:05 UTC, flag in #revops-forecast (Slack) so we can revert/patch before close of day.

Thanks all — good hustle.
Karthik
